selected_baseline: BiGRU + CTC with hand and motion features

day6_error_analysis.interpretation: The motion features reduce deletions but increase substitutions and insertions slightly. Deletion remains the largest error type.

runtime.caveat: Not end-to-end latency. Video decoding, MediaPipe extraction, greedy CTC decoding and UI operations were not included.

next_steps: Retain hand-only as the controlled baseline and hand-plus-motion as the preferred model.
Investigate deletion errors, spaces, digits, punctuation and short phrases.
For the web prototype, use the exact landmark schema and normalization expected by the selected checkpoint.
Validate the full video-to-landmark pipeline before claiming real-time performance.
Keep future model improvements separate from the current measured results.
limitations: The measured improvement in test CER is 0.31 percentage points and has not been tested for statistical significance.
Results apply to the evaluated FSboard split and do not prove generalization to arbitrary webcam videos.
